newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO buys 50 pct of investment firm.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO buys 50 pct of investment firm.

text.p: ABN AMRO NV has acquired a 50 percent stake in an eastern European/Russian investment banking firm, the Dutch bank said in a statement on Monday.

The company, MeesPierson EurAmerica Limited, specialises in arranging private equity and debt financing and providing mergers and acquisition services to domestic and international companies in the region and employs some 20 bankers, ABN AMRO said.
ABN AMRO bought the stake from merchant bank MeesPierson NV, a unit of Dutch-Belgian financial group Fortis.
No financial details of the deal were disclosed.

ABN AMRO said it planned to integrate its existing corporate finance activities in the regions with those of MeesPierson EurAmerica, which will be renamed ABN AMRO Hoare Govett Corporate Finance (CEE) Limited.
ABN AMRO said it expected eventually to acquire full control of the company.
